Historic canal crossing

About this place

This older bridge preserves the scale and brick detailing of a canal crossing. Sources vary in how precisely they date it, but it is recorded as a heritage monument. Notice how the bridge and the channel sit within the settlement rather than treating the structure as a stand-alone object.
